### Source References
1. **PDP8 (2023)** – *Quyết định 500/QĐ-TTg ngày 25 tháng 04 năm 2023 của Thủ tướng Chính phủ về Quy hoạch điện quốc gia thời kỳ 2021–2030, tầm nhìn đến năm 2050*. Annex 1 (Danh mục dự án điện), pp. 40–48.  
   🔗 https://moit.gov.vn/bo-cong-thuong-tuyen-bo-quyet-dinh-cua-thu-tuong-chinh-phuu-ve-quy-hoach-dien-quoc-gia-thoi-ky-2021-2030-tinh-hoa-den-nam-2050-quyet-dinh-500-qd-ttg-nam-2023.html
2. **Global Energy Monitor (GEM)** – *Vietnam Power Plant Tracker*. Provides unit-level commissioning dates, ownership, and status updates.  
   🔗 https://globalenergymonitor.org/projects/vietnam-power-plant-tracker/
3. **MOIT Power Sector Reports (2022–2024)** – *Báo cáo tình hình phát triển điện lực Việt Nam*. Published annually by the Ministry of Industry and Trade.  
   🔗 https://moit.gov.vn/van-ban-phap-quy.html (Search: “Báo cáo tình hình phát triển điện lực”)

### Notes on Methodology & Data Limitations
- **Fuel Classification**: Plants are listed by primary design fuel. Many gas/LNG facilities are dual-fuel capable and may switch between domestic gas, imported LNG, or (in rare cases) coal during supply disruptions.
- **Technology**: All operational and under-construction coal plants in Vietnam use subcritical technology. No USC or IGCC plants are commercially operational. All gas/LNG plants use CCGT.
- **Status & COD**: Dates reflect official PDP8 classifications and EVN/MOIT project milestones. Actual CODs may shift due to financing, grid integration, or supply chain factors.
- **Scope**: This inventory covers all thermal units >30 MWe. Smaller industrial captive plants, OCGT peakers, and biomass/diesel units are excluded per your threshold.
- **Future Assets**: PDP8 (2023) prioritizes gas/LNG and renewable capacity; new coal projects are limited to Nghi Sơn 3/4 and Duyên Hải 4, with strict emissions and efficiency requirements. No new greenfield coal plants are planned beyond 2025.

For real-time project tracking, consult EVN’s official project portal: https://evn.com.vn/en/ or MOIT’s Power Development Division: https://moit.gov.vn/bo-cong-thuong/bo-cong-thuong-tuyen-bo-quyet-dinh-cua-thu-tuong-chinh-phuu-ve-quy-hoach-dien-quoc-gia-thoi-ky-2021-2030-tinh-hoa-den-nam-2050-quyet-dinh-500-qd-ttg-nam-2023.html

Produce a complete, primary-sourced reference inventory of Vietnam's past, present and future thermal generation assets (> 30MWe) structured as follows:

## Structured power plants table

Tabulate for every thermal power plant in Vietnam:

| Name (Vietnamese) | Name (English) | Province | Fuel | Technology | Units × MW | Total MWe | Status | COD | Owner/Developer | Source 1 | Source 2 | Notes |

- Fuel: Coal / Domestic gas / Imported LNG
- Technology (coal): Subcritical / Supercritical / USC
- Technology (gas): CCGT / OCGT
- Status: Approved / Planned / Operational / Under construction / Suspended / Cancelled / Retired
- Total MWe: Include units > 30MWe.
- COD: Actual or expected commercial operation date
- Sources: specify where in the document, include URL
